name: worktree
description: Make git worktrees a first-class workspace in Claude Code: list, create, switch, and safely clean parallel worktrees, with the active worktree always visible in the status line. Adds Plan-Driven Lane Execution - one main agent orchestrating several worker sessions, each in its own isolated worktree lane, with delegation gates, a board derived from git, and central integration. Git stays the source of truth, PDLE is opt-in, and the plugin registers zero hooks by default.
